blurb: Castle Fun Park offers a variety of attractions including go-karts, laser maze, bowling, mini golf, and over 200 arcade games. It hosts birthday parties, corporate events, school field trips, and daycare outings with dedicated spaces and event coordinators. The park operates year-round with indoor facilities suitable for all ages.
extraNote: Outside food and beverages are not permitted · Playcards do not expire and have no inactivity fees
